items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਵਸਨੀਕ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਦੇ ਥਰਮਾਮੀਟਰ ਨੇ ਉਸੇ ਦਿਨ {D}°C ਰੀਡਿੰਗ ਦਿਖਾਈ.
items.gloss_en: A resident's home thermometer showed a reading of {D} °C that same day.
items.entity_note: belongs to a private resident's home thermometer (a person's instrument), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other city (a place)

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਨਿਵੇਸ਼ਕ ਦੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤ ਉਸੇ ਦਿਨ €{D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: An investor's personal account was valued at €{D} that same day.
items.entity_note: belongs to an individual investor (a person), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other company (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: ਜਲ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਮਾਪਕ ਯੰਤਰ ਨੇ ਉਸੇ ਦਿਨ {D} m ਰੀਡਿੰਗ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤੀ.
items.gloss_en: The water department's measuring instrument recorded a reading of {D} m that same day.
items.entity_note: belongs to the water department's own gauge (an organisation's instrument), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other lake (a place)

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਸਥਿਰ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਦੀ ਕੀਮਤ ਇਸੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ €{D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: A fixed deposit certificate was worth €{D} that same month.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different financial instrument (a certificate), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other savings account

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਗਾਹਕ ਦੇ ਲੌਇਲਟੀ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ €{D} ਸਨ.
items.gloss_en: Another customer's loyalty account had €{D} in it.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different customer (a person), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other gift card (an instrument)

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਮੈਂਬਰ ਨੇ ਉਸੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ {D} GB ਡਾਟਾ ਵਰਤਿਆ.
items.gloss_en: Another family member used {D} GB of data that same month.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different family member (a person), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other data plan (an instrument)

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਦੁਕਾਨ ਦੀ ਇਸੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ ਦੀ ਆਮਦਨ €{D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: A local shop's income for that same month was €{D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to a business (an organisation), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other household

items.distractor_fact: ਇਸ ਟੀਮ ਦੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਦੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਨੇ ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ {D} ਗੋਲ ਕੀਤੇ.
items.gloss_en: The team's top player scored {D} goals during the season.
items.entity_note: belongs to an individual player (a person), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other team (an organisation); same season, so it adds no ambiguity to the team's own goal difference

items.distractor_fact: ਇਸ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕ ਦੀ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਆਮਦਨ ਇਸੇ ਤਿਮਾਹੀ ਵਿੱਚ €{D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: The business owner's personal income for that same quarter was €{D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to the owner as a private individual (a person), a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other small business (an organisation)

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਰੇਲ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਔਸਤ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ ਰੀਡਿੰਗ {D} min ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: Another railway company's own average arrival reading was {D} min.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different railway company (an organisation) with its own unstated scheduled-time reference, a different kind of owner than the first distractor's train on another line (an instrument)

items.distractor_fact: ਇੱਕ ਲਿਫਟ ਸਾਂਭ-ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕੰਪਨੀ ਦੀ ਟੈਸਟ ਲਿਫਟ ਦੀ ਰੀਡਿੰਗ {D} ਸੀ.
items.gloss_en: A lift-maintenance company's test lift showed a reading of {D}.
items.entity_note: belongs to a maintenance company's own test lift (an organisation), with its own unstated ground-floor reference, a different kind of owner than the first distractor's other building (a place)
